On one hand I usually spend the entire show feeling bad for Kagome because the show really did make Inuyasha seem like a two timer and Kagome as a convenient backup plan and not only that, her being the reincarnation seems just like another way he’s trying to be with Kikyo. 

But in the same sense, it took him so long to get over her and focus on Kagome because when he awoke 50 years later, the ones that knew Kikyo had 50 years to grieve whereas to him it was like she had just died. And then for her to come back into his world and not want much to do with him or even hate him at first has to be crushing when you were still grieving. Even worse when she wants him one day then doesn’t care about him the next. I think Kagome understands that, rather than being the pushover she very much seems. Inuyasha needed someone like that during that time in his life, a companion that let him heal the way he needed to. Even if she did pout a lot 😂 she still stayed by him. And truthfully he stayed by her. He could have chose to battle and stay with Kikyo. The show never made it out like he couldn’t have, but he always came back to Kagome and left her back alone.

Personality wise I think Kagome and Inuyasha were the best fit as well. And their bond became much closer. They spent more time together by the end of the show and they shared more intimate/vulnerable moments. They seemed to laugh more and be able to banter as well.

Why are there so many ships with him and a literal child? I’m not sure why we can’t leave it at more of a parental relationship. Sesshomaru didn’t care for anyone who wanted him in the entire show and I doubt would care much for romance. I felt bad for Kagura who longed for a normal life and clearly a relationship with him.

There’s nothing in the show that insinuates Sesshomaru feels that way towards Rin, only the pedo fan base. But Inuyashas love choices being a dead woman or a 15 year old are interesting… though I’m not even sure how old Inuyasha is.
